label: Clarified butter
note: In German law Butterschmalz is the same product as Butterreinfett and wasserfreies Milchfett (at least 99.8 % fat, at most 0.1 % water; MilchPQV Anlage 8), see anhydrous milk fat. The household version is made by hand by melting and skimming.

about.text: Clarified butter is butter from which all milk solids have been removed. The result is a clear, yellow butter that can be heated to higher temperatures before burning.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Butter is melted gently and left to separate; the foam of whey protein is skimmed, the casein settles, and the clear fat is poured off. Nothing is browned, so the taste stays plain.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Butter is melted so the components separate by density: water evaporates, whey proteins float and casein sinks.

steps.name: skim
steps.note: The foam of whey protein is skimmed off.

steps.name: pour off
steps.note: The clear butterfat is poured off the top, leaving the solids behind.
